title: Council agenda triage
prompt: A local council has too many agenda items for one meeting. Which items need deep debate now, and which should be deferred with a clear reason?

contributions.body: Items with immediate legal deadlines should be surfaced first because delay can remove the council's choice entirely.
contributions.evidenceText: Some agenda items become moot if the window closes.

contributions.body: A routed digest should also surface one community-trust item even when it has no hard deadline, because repeated deferral compounds resentment.
contributions.evidenceText: Trust debt is slower, but still real.

contributions.body: The operator needs an export that explains why some items were deferred, or the agenda decision will look arbitrary later.
contributions.evidenceText: Decision records matter as much as the meeting itself.

responses.body: Yes. A compact digest helps during the meeting only if the export remains legible after the meeting.
